description: This Java class handles backup and restore operations for global preferences in the AnySoftKeyboard app. It manages multiple preference providers, serializes their data to XML, and provides methods to perform backup and restore processes using RxJava observables.

classes.name: GlobalPrefsBackup
classes.description: A utility class for backing up and restoring global preferences in the app.

classes.name: GlobalPrefsBackup.ProviderDetails
classes.description: A data class representing a preference provider and its display title.

methods.name: getAllAutoApplyPrefsProviders
methods.description: Returns a list with a single provider for auto-apply preferences.

methods.name: getAllPrefsProviders
methods.description: Returns a list of all preference providers used in the app.

methods.name: backupProvider
methods.description: Serializes a preference provider's root preferences into a parent prefs root.

methods.name: restoreProvider
methods.description: Restores preferences for a provider from a prefs root.

methods.name: backup
methods.description: Performs backup of enabled providers into an output stream.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores preferences from an input stream into enabled providers.

methods.name: doIt
methods.description: Core method that performs backup or restore operations based on provided functions.
